response.justification: The candidate has extensive experience in software development with a strong background in C and C++ (from National Instruments role), but lacks recent or deep C++ experience on Windows in capital markets/fixed income domains. While they meet some technical requirements (SQL, communication skills), their domain expertise is not aligned with fixed income, derivatives, or investment banking. Their recent work focuses heavily on web/mobile technologies and modern stacks, which may not directly translate to the role's needs.
strengths: Strong C++ experience (National Instruments role with C/C++ components)
Proven SQL and database management skills (MySQL, MongoDB)
Excellent verbal/written communication (evidenced by workshops, talks, and GitHub contributions)
concerns: No apparent fixed income, derivatives, or investment banking domain experience
Minimal recent Windows platform C++ development (last clear C++ role was 2014-2015)
Recent work emphasizes non-C++ stacks (TypeScript, Node.js, Python-like Dlang) rather than C++

key_factors.factor: Fixed income / capital markets domain expertise
